name: Seachem Flourish Iron
description: Ferrous-gluconate iron supplement for plants showing iron deficiency despite a comprehensive regimen. Seachem does not publish a per-dose ppm, so values are NOT disclosed — qualitative `affects` only.
notes: Gluconate iron is fast-uptake but short-lived in the water column. Label dose ~5 ml per 200 L; dose to correct visible Fe deficiency, not blindly.
